question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, and should that behavior be default-on, opt-in, or left to external ClawHub plugins?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and feasible in the plugin boundary, but it changes official plugin ranking semantics, config/defaults, persistent FTS index lifecycle, and fallback behavior.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, query-text propagation, explicit hybrid config/default policy, vector fallback, docs, and tests inside the plugin.

options.title: Keep advanced LanceDB retrieval external
options.body: Leave the official plugin vector-only and route BM25/reranker variants to external ClawHub or npm plugins such as the memory-lancedb-pro idea.

options.title: Document vector-only by design
options.body: Close the direction after explicitly documenting that memory-lancedb owns vector recall while memory-core and QMD own hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, query-text propagation, explicit hybrid config/default policy, vector fallback, docs, and tests inside the plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from memory-lancedb history, prior issue review context, and adjacent memory architecture ownership.
